rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts (≥2–3 distinct)
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy doc line 449 names M6's two earned themes explicitly: 'Themes earned: self-aware + grain of salt (the whole module is conversation with Claude about Claude's output across two runs; the artifacts rule, the self-reports don't); compounding.' File's Key Concepts (lines 40–44) instances compounding three times over (bullets 1, 4, 5 — 'the second authored skill IS the loop', 'encoding is the third phase...') but carries zero self-aware+grain-of-salt instance — no bullet touches Claude's self-report vs. the artefact, introspection, or verify-against-evidence. Sibling calibration: M5's Key Concepts (learn-from-the-test.md line 67) carries this exact theme as its own bullet — 'No benchmark told you what went wrong; the artefact did. The artefact rules, self-reports don't.' — near-verbatim to the strategy doc's own phrasing for that theme. M6's exercise body does practice the discipline (Phase 1 push-back: 'Expect over-credit on the packaging. A fair push-back is name one thing the verifier missed, concretely.') but it never surfaces as a Key Concepts bullet the way M5 distilled its own.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add one Key Concepts bullet naming self-aware+grain-of-salt, mirroring the M5 sibling's shape — e.g. distill the Phase 1 push-back move (Claude's read of its own two runs is a hypothesis, verify against the quoted artefact) into a stated discipline bullet, not just an exercise-body push-back move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs on 1–3 survivors
rules_evaluated.evidence: All 5 Key Concepts bullets (lines 40–44) pass §§3/4/5's per-bullet gates individually (discipline-led, no front-run), so all are breadcrumb-eligible survivors — but none carries a short thematic hook decorating a tactical statement. Contrast sibling plan-mode-done-right.md line 63: 'Structure is persuasive. A 7-item plan with headers looks like a decision even when it's a draft. At least 10% wrong.' — a tactical bullet + trailing theme-essence hook. M6's bullets are either purely tactical (bullets 2, 3) or already theme-shaped as a whole statement without a separable hook (bullets 1, 4, 5); zero breadcrumb-shaped decoration anywhere in the section. Non-blocking per template (breadcrumb decoration excluded from the blocking list), but the section shows a real gap in this specific shape, not just a mechanical omission — same root cause as rule 5.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Once rule 5's self-aware+grain-of-salt bullet lands, breadcrumb-decorate it or one other survivor with a short 5–8 word hook in the house's unbolded-trailing-clause style (no literal 'Remember:' prefix — that's not current house practice per sibling modules).
